interpretation: Pinned NTFS3 super.c requires65536 unsigned16-bit entries. upcase.c supplies comparison context, but its ASCII shortcut and optional raw tie-break are not adopted as universal filesystem policy. This primitive reads all supplied entries exactly and returns both orders separately. No complete namespace/collation or source-binding claim.
